input: Read /data/poem.txt and find the 3 most frequently used words. Print each word with its count, one per line, sorted by frequency descending.

transcript.final_response:
The 3 most frequently used words in `/data/poem.txt` sorted by frequency descending:

the: 8
on: 3
cat: 2
tool_calls: tr -cs '[:alnum:]' '[\n*]' < /data/poem.txt | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | grep -v '^$' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head -n 3
awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) count[$i]++} END {for(w in count) print count[w], w}' /data/poem.txt | sort -k1,1nr -k2,2
awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) count[$i]++} END {for(w in count) print w, count[w]}' /data/poem.txt | sort -k2,2nr

tool_outputs.stdout:
the cat sat on the mat
the cat in the hat
the dog on the log
the frog on the bog
